svg.title: Set up an LLC
svg.desc: Form an LLC: name check, Articles of Organization with a registered agent, a signed operating agreement, then the EIN, bank account, and state-tax registrations. The default for holding companies, agencies, and bootstrapped businesses — founders planning to raise priced venture rounds should incorporate a Delaware C-Corp instead, and an LLC that later takes that path runs the statutory conversion (see Convert an LLC to a C-Corp).
